mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after a rideshare accident in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a rideshare accident, your first priority is safety. Check for injuries and call 911 for medical attention and to report the incident. Document the scene by taking photos of vehicles, damage, and surroundings. Gather contact information from all parties involved, including the rideshare driver, any other drivers, and witnesses. Do not admit fault or discuss the accident in detail with anyone other than law enforcement and medical professionals. Seek legal advice promptly to understand your rights and protect your claim.
